passages.heading: MD&A
passages.text: .” B. Bu siness Overview The Viking Difference 1. One Brand : Among our guests and across the industry, the Viking brand is synonymous with excellence. Our guests can experience all three categories of the cruise industry—ocean, river and expedition cruising—under our single brand. Rather than creating a conglomerate of different brands, all of our products are a consistent extension of the Viking brand. As a result, our marketing spend and strong brand loyalty drive growth for all of our products. We also leverage our strong brand loyalty for future product launches, with over 60% of bookings for each of the inaugural seasons for Viking Ocean, Viking Expedition and Viking Mississippi made by past guests. Our guests know they can expect a consistent, excellent experience on each voyage they take with us, which has allowed us to expand our travel platform successfully with new destinations and experiences. Our repeat guest percentage has steadily increased over time from 27% for the 2015 season to 54% for the 2025 season. 2. Nearly Identical Small Ships : Our fleet includes 59 Longships accommodating 190 passengers, 12 ocean ships, including the Viking Yidun , accommodating 930 or 998 passengers and two expedition ships accommodating 378 passengers. Within each product, our ships are nearly identical and indistinguishable to our guests. This simplifies the sales and marketing process and creates operational flexibility, as well as efficiencies around shipbuilding, maintenance and crew, which improves our margins. Our small ships can dock in ports where larger ships cannot, providing our guests more time ashore for cultural discovery and exploration and offering our guests experiences they cannot have with other cruise lines. 3. Clearly Defined, Destination-Focused Experience : We are the only cruise line offering experiences on all seven continents with itineraries across five oceans, 21 rivers and five lakes, and a focus primarily on destinations in Europe and the Mediterranean, rather than the Caribbean. We deliver a highly differentiated experience for our guests by prioritizing exploration of the destination versus onboard consumption and traditional entertainment. The Viking experience is well-defined and all-inclusive, with a shore excursion included in every port. We are also known for the things that we do not do. For example, no children under 18, no casinos and no hidden ancillary costs, such as charges for alternative restaurants, wi-fi or beer and wine at lunch and dinner. Because of these strategic choices, our guests instantly recognize the Viking way of travel. 4. Clear Customer Focus : We are intently focused on the travel needs of our core demographic of curious, affluent, English-speaking travelers aged 55 years and older, which is an attractive segment of the travel market. We believe we know our core demographic better than anyone else in the industry and we have tailored our products to specifically address the travel needs of the Thinking Person. credit_strengths.text: Viking's operating cash flow comfortably covers gross interest expense, with coverage in the low single digits and cash conversion well above the sector median, reflecting a premium, destination-focused cruise model that generates predictable advance bookings and repeat demand across ocean, river and expedition segments.

Net leverage sits materially below the sector median and within the minimal risk tier, supported by a large unrestricted cash balance that offsets a substantial portion of reported borrowings, leaving meaningful headroom before any threshold migration.

key_risks.text: The debt note discloses a large unsecured senior note maturity in the near term alongside secured notes due shortly after, concentrating refinancing needs; a meaningful portion of the fleet is pledged as security, which could constrain new secured borrowing if refinancing conditions tighten.

Current liabilities exceed current assets, producing a current ratio below the sector median, and the disclosed debt maturity profile shows a sizeable current portion of long-term debt, indicating near-term liquidity pressure that cash on hand only partly mitigates.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Operating income covers gross interest expense multiple times over, and operating cash flow is a substantial multiple of reported borrowings, indicating that scheduled debt service is comfortably supported by recurring earnings and cash generation at current levels.

Cash on the balance sheet covers a large share of reported borrowings, and net debt is modest relative to the EBITDA proxy; however, capital expenditure is not separately tagged, so free cash flow after fleet investment cannot be verified and remains a material data gap for assessing true debt-servicing headroom.

overall_credit_view.text: Viking presents a minimal indicative financial risk profile, with net leverage below the sector median and cash flow coverage of debt well above it; the premium brand, young fleet and diversified itinerary base support earnings resilience through the travel cycle.

Analyst judgement is that refinancing execution around the near-term note maturities is the key swing factor; absent that, leverage headroom and cash generation suggest the issuer can absorb moderate EBITDA declines before approaching the next risk threshold, though the Altman zone flags balance-sheet caution.

credit_strengths.text: Viking 的營運現金流足以輕鬆覆蓋總利息支出，覆蓋倍數處於低單位數，而現金轉換率遠高於行業中位數，反映其專注目的地的高端郵輪模式，能在遠洋、內河及探險航段產生可預測的預訂收入及重複需求。
淨槓桿顯著低於行業中位數，並處於最低風險級別，主要由於龐大的未受限現金結餘抵銷了相當部分的已報告借款，在觸及任何門檻遷移前仍有充裕緩衝。

key_risks.text: 債務票據披露了一筆短期內到期的大額無抵押優先票據，以及緊隨其後到期的有抵押票據，令再融資需求集中；船隊中有相當部分已抵押作為擔保，若再融資環境收緊，可能限制新的有抵押借款。
流動負債超過流動資產，導致流動比率低於行業中位數，而披露的債務到期結構顯示長期債務中有龐大的流動部分，反映短期流動性壓力，手頭現金僅能部分緩解。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 營運收入覆蓋總利息支出達數倍，而營運現金流相對已報告借款亦為可觀倍數，顯示按現時水平，經常性盈利及現金產生能力足以輕鬆支持預定的債務償付。
資產負債表上的現金覆蓋已報告借款的一大部分，而淨債務相對 EBITDA 代理指標而言屬溫和；然而，資本開支並未單獨標示，因此船隊投資後的自由現金流無法核實，仍是評估真實債務償付緩衝的重要數據缺口。

overall_credit_view.text: Viking 呈現最低的指示性財務風險狀況，淨槓桿低於行業中位數，而現金流對債務的覆蓋則遠高於中位數；高端品牌、年輕船隊及多元化航線基礎支持其盈利在旅遊週期中的韌性。
分析師判斷認為，圍繞短期票據到期的再融資執行是關鍵變數；若撇除該因素，槓桿緩衝及現金產生能力顯示發行人可在接近下一個風險門檻前吸納溫和的 EBITDA 跌幅，儘管 Altman 區域對資產負債表發出審慎訊號。
